entries.1caac0fcee7b75b9: A non-ferrous metal recycling group headquartered in Imizu, Toyama Prefecture
entries.1e1060beadc22219: Designated to the First Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange
entries.2e48e6aee1d2af0e: As a management policy since its founding, it has set out “Effective use of resources in Japan, which has few natural resources, carried out in a highly transparent manner,” and states that, through metal recycling, it aims to become a corporate group that can fulfill its social responsibilities toward realizing a low-carbon, recycling-based society. In the Non-Ferrous Metal Business, it states that non-ferrous metal recycling is its core business and that it will work on measures to strengthen its competitiveness. Regarding overseas operations, following its bases in the US and Thailand, it states that it aims to further expand its business overseas.

entries.b746065362d16ec3: In the fiscal year ended August 2025, net sales of the Non-Ferrous Metal Business, at ¥81,905 million, accounted for the majority, while the Arts and Crafts Business was ¥558 million. By product, recycled raw materials were ¥46,125 million and ingots were ¥35,548 million. Its largest customer is Nakashima Propeller Co., Ltd., which accounted for 10.8% of sales in the fiscal year ended August 2025. Sales are mainly to customers in Japan, and there are also sales to overseas destinations such as South Korea, China and North America.

entries.bb2f8d56545e18c9: As a management policy since its founding, it has set out “Effective use of resources in Japan, which has few natural resources, carried out in a highly transparent manner,” and states that, through metal recycling, it aims to become a corporate group that can fulfill its social responsibilities toward realizing a low-carbon, recycling-based society.
entries.bcd01db8f56d71f4: This business centers on copper and other nonferrous metal-related operations.
entries.c80e09da17172726: This business blends and melts recycled copper and copper alloy raw materials collected from domestic and overseas sources, producing approximately 50 varieties of products in shapes and weights tailored to customers' needs and applications. The main varieties are aluminum bronze, used as raw material for ship propellers, and bronze, lead-free bronze and brass for the housing industry, such as faucet fittings. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥35,548 million.
entries.d3ebc31d53daecab: This business processes approximately 150 varieties of non-ferrous metal recycled raw materials collected from domestic and overseas suppliers, through sorting, pressing and other methods, and sells them to electric wire manufacturers, copper smelting manufacturers and others. They are also used as melting materials for the company's own ingot production. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥46,125 million.
entries.d5c457c25f5df7cb: This business centers on copper and other nonferrous metal-related operations. It has two pillars: manufacturing and sales of ingots, and processing and sales of recycled raw materials. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥81,905 million.
entries.d8369b6445c33227: Because it handles ingots and recycled raw materials at the same time, it can buy miscellaneous non-ferrous metals in bulk. It has the technology and facilities to analyze each recycled raw material, and manufactures ingots that meet domestic and overseas standards and the proprietary standards specified by customers.
